name: Deafening Bull Rush (Combat)
body:
As you slam into your enemy, they are deafened by the attack.

Prerequisite(s): Power Attack, Improved Bull Rush

Benefit: When making a successful Bull Rush, you deafen the target creature for 1d4 rounds.
